implementation_status: partial; declarative source, private pickup and current-recipient energy routing; calibration and production assembly remain incomplete

sources.support: Tempering creates Firesprites on Solar weapon kills while active. Does not establish all current shared-buff or cooldown policies.
Current general ability energy scaling; does not measure or identify the stat basis of the Compendium Firesprite 11.25% value.

tempering.firesprite_trigger: Solar weapon kills while Tempering active

current_content_policies.cooldown: One owner-wide generation cooldown, starting only after confirmed physical creation. Rejected creation does not start it; collection does not reset it. Unknown creation results stop, without retry.
current_content_policies.first_kill: New buff rules are not retroactively attached to the activating kill. An already-active buff may spawn on that kill.
current_content_policies.shared_buff: All producers stack and refresh one eight-second recipient buff. No per-producer bonus multiplication.
current_content_policies.ally_trigger: Any recipient of the active shared buff can request its own private Firesprite on its own Solar weapon kill, even without the fragment. Requires current D2 verification.
current_content_policies.unequip: Existing buff lives until expiry; existing pickup continuation survives source removal. Fragment penalty disappears when unbound.
current_content_policies.source: Each player has exactly one bound firesprite_system source. Pickup creator is that system source; initiating kill remains in the continuation cause. Does not claim weapon-origin propagation on pickup facts.
current_content_policies.stats: Health/Class/AE are stat queries only; physical health recovery, class scaling and airborne accuracy are not projected yet.
current_content_policies.collection: Current base grenade selection, resource and stat/CES; absent or costless selection and full energy still consume the unit and publish pickup fact.
current_content_policies.placement: Use the triggering receipt EntityObservation victim/feet point through event_position_observed + read_event_position. Death reactions may move or remove the corpse without relocating the pickup. Missing anchor evidence emits firesprite_position_unobserved; recorded unavailable, foreign dimension or unloaded area is rejected by the ordinary world spawn. No current-position fallback, forced loading or cooldown on rejection. Receipt-time feet placement is a content policy pending actual D2 sampling calibration.

required_calibration.chorus_d2:firesprite_collection_radius: meter -> meter; original contact range absent from source
required_calibration.chorus_d2:firesprite_base_energy: charge_fraction -> charge_fraction; convert the quoted .1125 to the chosen current stat-zero pre-CES basis; no default or implicit legacy multiplier

synthetic_acceptance.normalization_confidence: unverified reference-basis hypothesis for exercising the pipeline, not a measured current Firesprite number
synthetic_acceptance.recipient_fixture: Arcbolt .75 CES; 100 Grenade stat factor 2.25; expected .084375 after test normalization
synthetic_acceptance.weapon: Two synthetic 10-damage rifles, no Incandescent perk; actual physical kill receipts
synthetic_acceptance.world_lifetime: Tests retain the 25-second content lifetime and five-second cooldown rather than shortening them
synthetic_acceptance.death_cleanup: Searing native and physical kills, and Tempering physical kills, move/remove the corpse before kill processing. Pickup remains at recorded death position; physical collection credits current grenade energy once.
